name: Eber
overview: Eber is a male figure identified as a Gadite, as noted in 1 Chronicles 5:11-13. Though specific details about his life are minimal, he is recognized within the tribe of Gad. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Eber' means '[regions] beyond [the river],' reflecting a geographical or ancestral significance. This proper name, mentioned in 1 Chronicles 5:13, was not given directly by God but holds meaning connected to his identity.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Eber as a descendant of Gad, linking him genealogically within the tribe of Gad according to 1 Chronicles 5:13. Beyond this, no further family relationships are explicitly documented in the provided references.
scriptureSignificance: Eber holds importance in the biblical lineage as a key ancestor within the post-flood world, connecting the godly line from Noah through Shem to Abraham. His name is foundational for the Hebrew people, as 'Hebrew' derives from 'Eber.' This link underscores his role in preserving God's covenantal promises through successive generations.
